artworks.title: Ariccia Seen from across a Valley
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite heightened with white, on brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a hillside town. The town's buildings are depicted with soft brushstrokes, displaying classical architectural elements. The horizon is placed higher in the image, allowing a view of the town's ridgeline. In the foreground, there are outlines of trees and bushes in tan and soft brown shades. A viaduct with arches stretches across the landscape in the distance. The sky is a muted gray-blue tone, possibly indicating a calm or overcast atmosphere. The use of neutral tones and fine lines gives the drawing a contemplative quality.

artworks.title: The Ruins of the Monastery of Oybin in the Zittau Mountains
artworks.medium: watercolor with gouache and pen and black ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a vast expanse stretching out and hills in the distance. Ruined structures are visible on a rocky hill, surrounded by greenery. The sky meets the hills on the horizon. The brushwork is soft and smooth, especially in the clouds and sky. The color palette includes blues, greens, and browns. A waterway reflects the scene with a bridge, cattle grazing, and a figure tending to them. scattered houses are nestled among trees in the background.

artworks.title: The Artist's Son, Heinrich Isaak Chodowiecki
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This image shows the upper portion of a person's body in profile view. The individual is facing to the left side of the frame, with the head and shoulder areas visible in detail. The person's facial features include a nose, lips, and chin, with the face in a relaxed expression. The hair is pulled back neatly into a small bun. The clothing depicted is a coat with large buttons on the shoulder. The background consists of uniform textured shading that contrasts with the lighter, detailed depiction of the person.

artworks.title: David with the Head of Goliath
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a man from his chest upwards, in profile facing right. The man's facial features are detailed, including a strong nose and expressive eyes. His hair is wavy and flowing. He is depicted with a piece of cloth draped over his shoulder and holding another head with closed eyes and long hair. The background consists of fine cross-hatching lines, and the artist's inscription is at the bottom.

artworks.title: Standard-Bearer for the Canton of Bern
artworks.medium: white-line woodcut on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
image: 19.1 x 10.6 cm (7 1/2 x 4 3/16 in.) (irregular)
mount: 21.5 x 13.5 cm (8 7/16 x 5 5/16 in.) (irregular)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person wearing armor holding a flag with a bear on it, standing on a floral pattern. The image depicts a figure with exaggerated musculature, adorned in a suit of armor, and grasping a flag pole. The flag features a large bear, which appears prominent on the fabric. Beneath the bear is a smaller, ornate scene. The word "BERN" is inscribed alongside an elaborate, decorative flourish beneath the figure, which is positioned amidst intricate floral motifs in the background. The style of the artwork is characteristic of woodcut printmaking, highlighting strong contrasts and detailed line work.

artworks.title: A Midnight Race on the Mississippi
artworks.medium: color lithograph with hand-coloring on wove paper
artworks.description: Fire burps out the top of a pair of smokestacks on two steamboats that power down a wide river at night in this color lithograph. Black smoke billows back from the flames, and steam hisses from smaller smokestacks at the back of the boats. The boat to our left is the Natchez, and writing around its name reads, “Vicksburg, Natchez and New Orleans Mail Line.” The other boat is the Eclipse. People line the decks of both as the boats race under the moonlit sky. A blanket of gray clouds breaks in front of the luminous moon. Printed text below the image reads, “A MIDNIGHT RACE ON THE MISSISSIPPI.” Tiny text printed under the lower left corner of the image reads, “F.F. PALMER DEL. FROM A SKETCH BY H.D. MANNING OF THE NATCHEZ” and “LITH. OF CURRIER & IVES, N.Y.” in the lower right.

artworks.title: Cavalry Battle
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The composition is dynamic and filled with figures engaged in combat, riding horses and wielding weapons. The figures are drawn with quick strokes that convey movement, and the scene appears dense with overlapping figures. The medium appears to be pen and ink, with washed tones adding depth to certain elements like the charging horses and the movement of the combatants. The drawing captures the intensity and disorder of a battlefield, with swirling lines and shading suggesting dust and movement.

artworks.title: Conversation Piece
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper, laid down on old mount
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals seated around a table in a room. Both figures are visible from head to toe. They are engaged in a conversation. The person on the left is leaning slightly forward, while the person on the right is seated with their back against the chair. Their facial features are not detailed, and their hair is styled in an 18th-century manner. The person on the left wears a jacket over a shirt, and the person on the right wears a dress with a decorative pattern. Various objects are present in the room, including a sculpted chair, a clock on the wall, and a decorative backdrop with a painting or frame above them. The room is decorated with elements like a fireplace, a decorative urn, and ornamental features, giving it an elegant atmosphere. There is also a small dog and a hanging birdcage in the background.

artworks.title: The Maréchal de Brissac
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite and chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien in honor of Meg Grasselli, for a long friendship
artworks.description: The image shows an older man standing in a side profile pose. He has gray, wavy hair tied back and is wearing an elaborate outfit with a salmon-colored coat, a patterned vest, a white ruffled shirt, red stockings, and black shoes with a buckle. He has a black sash across his chest and is holding a walking cane or staff. The background features a stone staircase, a building with columns, sculptures on the rooftop, trees, and a clear sky.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Girl
artworks.medium: salted paper print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro
artworks.description: The image shows a young girl standing beside a table. She has a serious expression and is dressed in a light top with dark accents, a dark skirt, white stockings, and black shoes. She has straight hair pulled back with a headband and a gold ring on her left hand. The background features a painted backdrop with a large column, decorative foliage, and a ground with green and gold tiles.

artworks.title: The Diplomat
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Given by Adult Program and Foreign Language Docents in Memory of Laura Wyman
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man in profile from the waist up, seated in a chair. He faces the right side, with his head slightly tilted forward. The man has facial features including a pronounced nose and a beard. He has sparse, graying hair and wears a draped garment. Fabric surrounds him as he is seated comfortably. In his lap, there is a dark hat. The background is textured and dark, contrasting with the lighter depiction of the man. The image is signed with elegant penmanship at the bottom right.

artworks.title: Three Fisher Girls, Tynemouth
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This is a painting of three women standing on a rocky shore. The women have brown hair and pale skin in shades of peach and blue-gray, and they wear dark blue dresses with gray aprons, with shawls in shades of blue and gray wrapped around their heads and shoulders. Two of the women are holding wide baskets, and the third has a large net balanced on her shoulder. Their clothing and the strings of the net seem to be blown to the right by the wind. On the left, the horizon shows two sailboats on the water in the distance against a cloudy gray sky. On the right is a rocky hill in shades of brown, gray, and green, and the ground beneath the women's feet is a similar blend of colors.

artworks.title: Woman in a Crinoline on the Beach of Trouville
artworks.medium: watercolor with gouache over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a woman sitting on a raised surface, facing left. She is holding a book and appears to be engaged with it. Her hair is styled in an updo with a hat or headpiece. She wears a black skirt, a white blouse with puffy sleeves, and a black shawl. Some sketchy outlines of other figures are around her: a child with a small parasol on the left and two indistinct figures on the right. The background is sparse with a light brown wash, hinting at an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: The Supper at Emmaus
artworks.artist: José del Castillo, after Mateo Cerezo the younger
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Given by Adult Program and Foreign Language Docents in Memory of Laura Wyman
artworks.description: The image shows an artwork of several men gathered around a table. The central figure is seated with a halo around his head, looking upward, along with a few other figures. One man is seated across the table, raising his hand, while another covers his face with one hand. The figures have facial hair and long hair, dressed in flowing garments. Additional figures are around them, with a drapery hanging behind and a cherubic figure in the clouds above. A scenic landscape is visible through an archway to the right, adding depth. Text at the bottom provides context or information about the artwork.

artworks.title: A River and Cottage with White Paling
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite with gouache and scratching out on wove paper
artworks.description: The painting depicts a landscape with a serene body of water in the foreground. In the center, there is a wooden bridge with figures walking over it. To the right, there is a rustic house surrounded by greenery and a white picket fence. The sky is filled with clouds ranging from light cream to dark gray. The color palette includes earthy tones, muted grays, and blues. Birds can be seen in the sky and near the water.

artworks.title: God Appearing to Moses
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I, after Maarten van Cleef
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene in a pastoral landscape. The central figure is kneeling and removing footwear, while another figure is kneeling in prayer. A divine figure emerges from a cloud above them, gesturing from within a radiant area. The landscape features sheep, a shepherd, a village or town, and rolling hills. The drawing is detailed, with intricate hatchwork and shading, conveying a religious narrative.

artworks.title: Moses and Aaron before the Pharaoh
artworks.artist: Johan Wierix, after Maarten van Cleef
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a court scene with a king, advisors, and onlookers. The image shows a throne with the king seated on it, surrounded by figures engaged in conversation. In the foreground, there is a dog on a checkered floor and a serpent coiled on the ground. The background features ornate columns and structures. The engraving technique highlights the texture of clothing and expressions of the figures, emphasizing the drama in the scene.

artworks.title: The Taskmaster of the Pharaoh Beating the Israelites
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I, Maarten van Cleef
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene depicting laborers and overseers in an ancient setting. The image shows several figures in various poses of labor, with some carrying heavy loads such as bricks and baskets, others working with tools. A man in a commanding posture is wielding a whip, overseeing the labor. In the background, there are structures resembling fortifications or castles, with smoke rising from the buildings. The scene illustrates a bustling environment, with a mix of labor and historical city buildings, backed by a rural landscape. The style captures a sense of narrative through body language and setting, typical of historical illustrations.

artworks.title: The Plague of Frogs
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I, after Maarten van Cleef
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a scene with a dining area and an outdoor scene filled with animals. The drawing shows a dramatic depiction of a scene set in a classical architectural setting, with a group of individuals gathered around a table within a colonnade, engaging in what appears to be a formal or celebratory meal. Outside, figures are shown in distress amidst swarms of frogs. The architecture includes columns and arches. The lines and shading capture the tension and chaos of the scene, with animals interacting with the individuals and the environment.

artworks.title: The Plague of Locusts
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I, after Maarten van Cleef
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a historic scene. The background shows an elaborately illustrated building with classical style architecture. In the forefront, there are several muscular figures engaged in different activities. One central figure wields a sword and confronts others who stand defensively or gesture dramatically. The floor is covered in grasshoppers, adding to the intensity of the scene. The etching showcases intricate linework and attention to detail, typical of Renaissance engravings focused on allegorical or historical themes.

artworks.title: Preparation for the Passover
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I, after Maarten van Cleef
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people preparing a meal or religious ritual. The image depicts several figures gathered around a table on which lies a lamb or goat. They are engaging in a detailed task. The setting appears to be indoors, with a large circular window casting light on the scene. To the right, there is an outdoor scene visible through an open doorway, showing an angel with a sword and several figures in the water. Architectural structures in the background include a medieval cityscape with tall towers. A small dog is present in the foreground.

artworks.title: The Exodus from Egypt
artworks.artist: Jan Sadeler I, after Maarten van Cleef
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large group of people carrying various objects and preparing for a journey. The scene is busy with activity as people are laden with items. The landscape features a hilly background with a procession of people continuing into the distance. The artistic style employs fine, detailed lines typical of engravings, showcasing intricate detailing of clothing and expressions. This image captures a moment of organized chaos, where individuals are actively engaged in the logistics of movement.

artworks.title: The Crossing of the Red Sea
artworks.artist: Johan Wierix, after Maarten van Cleef
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting a chariot drawn by horses surrounded by turbulent waters and clouds. The central figure is falling from the chariot with a distressed expression as swirling waves rise around them. To one side, multiple figures and spears push forward, highlighting the chaos. The horses show tension and motion, with expressive eyes and flared nostrils as they struggle against the forces. Large, ominous clouds fill the sky, with weapons scattered amidst the waves, adding to the sense of conflict and urgency.

artworks.title: A Seated Man Contemplating a Sunlit Mountain Valley
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Joan and David Maxwell
artworks.description: The image shows a valley surrounded by mountains, with cliffs blocking the horizon. The painting has loose brushstrokes in an impressionistic style, using a muted color palette. Vegetation is depicted in various greens, while rocks are shown in browns and grays. The sky is a pale color. A figure in dark clothing is seated on a slope, looking at the landscape, with trees and shrubs around them. Further away, there are cliffs with greenery, creating a dramatic backdrop.
